title: Atlas Lattice SourceRecord v0.1
description: Immutable raw-source receipt used before normalization into physics_profile properties. Raw stays recoverable.

source_locator.description: Dataset, table, record, page, line, nuclide key, or other locator.

release_metadata.description: Release identity required when upstream IDs can change. For ENSDF API this should include dataGeneratedAt and API/schema version when available.

raw_record.description: Unnormalized source payload or exact transcribed record.

retrieval_request.description: Optional deterministic request metadata: endpoint/query, sparse fields, pagination, or file selector.

x-atlas-invariants: SourceRecord is append-only/immutable after capture; corrections create a new SourceRecord.
Raw source representation is preserved before normalization.
Transient upstream database IDs are never treated as durable identity without release metadata.
Synthetic fixtures are never admissible as scientific evidence.
A normalized property may cite multiple SourceRecords; disagreement is preserved rather than overwritten.
